correctness.rationale: The disease-free Jacobian is triangular, so its two multipliers are reconstructed exactly. Their −1 conditions meet at \(h=2/d\) and \(\lambda=dr/A\), and the determinant of their parameter gradients is \(-2A/d\neq0\). On the invariant disease-free boundary, the map at \(h=2/d\) is exactly the affine involution \(x\mapsto2A/d-x\), so the period-two continuum follows identically. Multiplying the exact transverse derivatives at the paired points gives \(1-(2ru/A)^2\). The bundled checker independently replays the rational witness and all critical finite arithmetic.
